headline: A first in 144 years will happen! The new period officially starts tomorrow
summary: The mandatory dual price display used during Bulgaria's euro transition ends on 8 August 2026. From 9 August, prices will be shown only in euros, and inspections against unfair price increases will continue.
why: Bulgaria adopted the euro, and the end of dual pricing marks the completion of the currency changeover for consumers and businesses.
